SELECT COALESCE(day_stats.session_count, 0) AS sessionCount, COALESCE(day_stats.visitor_count, 0) AS visitorCount, COALESCE(day_stats.known_visitor_count, 0) AS knownVisitorCount, COALESCE(day_stats.stranger_visitor_count, 0) AS strangerVisitorCount, COALESCE(open_stats.open_session_count, 0) AS openSessionCount, COALESCE(day_stats.closed_dwell_seconds, 0) AS closedDwellSeconds, COALESCE(day_stats.open_dwell_seconds, 0) AS openDwellSeconds FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS session_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'p:' || ps.person_id::text ELSE 't:' || ps.track_key END)::bigint AS visitor_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps.person_id IS NOT NULL AND p.person_type IN ('student', 'staff') THEN ps.person_id END)::bigint AS known_visitor_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps.person_id IS NULL THEN ps.track_key WHEN p.person_type = 'stranger' THEN 'p:' || ps.person_id::text END)::bigint AS stranger_visitor_count, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN ps.status = 'closed' THEN ps.dwell_seconds ELSE 0 END ), 0)::bigint AS closed_dwell_seconds, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN ps.status = 'open' THEN GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - ps.arrival_at))))::bigint ELSE 0 END ), 0)::bigint AS open_dwell_seconds FROM presence_sessions ps LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.id = ps.person_id
) day_stats CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ps.person_id)::bigint AS open_session_count FROM presence_sessions ps INNER JOIN persons p ON p.id = ps.person_id
AND p.person_type IN ('student', 'staff')
AND
AND 1 = 0
AND
) open_stats

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ps.arrival_at)::int AS hour, COUNT(*)::bigint AS arrivalCount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN ps.status = 'closed' THEN ps.dwell_seconds ELSE GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - ps.arrival_at))))::bigint END ), 0)::bigint AS dwellSeconds FROM presence_sessions ps
GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ps.arrival_at) ORDER BY hour

SELECT ps.id AS sessionId, ps.person_id AS personId, COALESCE(p.display_name, '未知访客') AS displayName, COALESCE(p.person_type::text, 'stranger') AS personKind, COALESCE(p.employee_no, '') AS employeeNo, c.device_name AS deviceName, ps.arrival_at AS arrivalAt, ps.departure_at AS departureAt, ps.status::text AS status, CASE WHEN ps.status = 'closed' THEN ps.dwell_seconds::bigint ELSE GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - ps.arrival_at))))::bigint END AS dwellSeconds, fp.image_url AS face_image_url FROM presence_sessions ps INNER JOIN camera c ON c.id = ps.camera_id LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.id = ps.person_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT image_url FROM face_profiles WHERE person_id = ps.person_id ORDER BY quality_score DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT 1 ) fp ON ps.person_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.arrival_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id AS personId, p.display_name AS displayName, p.person_type::text AS personKind, p.employee_no AS employeeNo, COALESCE(p.note, '') AS note, COALESCE(p.face_image_url, fp.image_url) AS face_image_url, NULL::text AS body_image_url, latest.arrival_at AS lastSeenAt FROM persons p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ps.arrival_at FROM presence_sessions ps WHERE ps.person_id = p.id ORDER BY ps.arrival_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT image_url FROM face_profiles WHERE person_id = p.id ORDER BY quality_score DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT 1 ) fp ON TRUE WHERE p.person_type IN ('student', 'staff') AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM face_profiles x WHERE x.person_id = p.id) OR (p.face_image_url IS NOT NULL AND p.face_image_url <> '') ) ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT ps.track_key AS track_key, fp.embedding::text AS embedding_text FROM presence_sessions ps INNER JOIN face_profiles fp ON fp.person_id = ps.person_id WHERE ps.track_key IS NOT NULL AND ps.track_key <> '' AND ps.person_id IS NOT NULL AND ps.arrival_at >= #{beginDate}::date AND ps.arrival_at < (#{endDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM persons p WHERE p.id = ps.person_id AND p.person_type = 'stranger' ) ORDER BY fp.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id AS personId, p.display_name AS displayName, p.employee_no AS employeeNo, p.person_type::text AS personType, COALESCE(fp.image_url, p.face_image_url, '') AS faceImageUrl FROM persons p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT image_url FROM face_profiles WHERE person_id = p.id ORDER BY quality_score DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT 1 ) fp ON TRUE WHERE p.person_type IN ('student', 'staff')
AND ( p.display_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.employee_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY p.display_name LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE persons SET display_name = #{displayName}, person_type = CAST(#{personType} AS person_type), employee_no = #{employeeNo}, note = #{note}, phone = COALESCE(#{phone}, phone, ''), gender = COALESCE(#{gender}, gender, '2'), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{personId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM persons WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo} LIMIT 1

UPDATE presence_sessions SET status = CAST(#{status} AS session_status), departure_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'closed' THEN COALESCE(departure_at, NOW()) ELSE NULL END, dwell_seconds = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'closed' THEN GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(departure_at, NOW()) - arrival_at))))::int ELSE NULL END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{sessionId}
